headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress as Sunday NQ price discovery begins
body: NQ has reopened, but sufficiently current independent bar-level evidence is not yet available to establish a persistent one-way path. Strait of Hormuz disruption and Sunday Russia-Ukraine/NATO developments keep Stress extreme, while the modest delayed futures indication does not by itself establish mean-reversion failure.
